public_checks.rationale: The registered public adapter observed both cluster-scoped-owner cases with exception null. OBS3 and OBS4 both contain ownerReferences to Parent global-parent/parent-uid-1. This satisfies the observed no-LookupError and owner-reference requirements for those finite public cases.

OBS3 shows the cluster-child Namespace case with exception null and metadata containing labels/name/ownerReferences but no metadata.namespace key. This supports that the cluster-scoped child remained namespace-less in the public local-adopt observation.

OBS4 shows the explicit-child-namespace ConfigMap case with exception null and metadata.namespace still set to work-ns, while also carrying the owner reference. This supports namespace preservation for that public case.
